description_en: Controls whether tool call inputs stream from the API as Claude generates them. With this off, a large tool input such as a long file write arrives only after Claude finishes generating it, which can look like it's hanging. Enabled by default for direct Anthropic API connections. Set to `0` to opt out. Set to `1` to force-enable even when the server-side default is off. Has no effect on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or [gateway](/en/llm-gateway) connections
description_ja: APIからのツール実行入力のストリーミングを制御し、大きな入力が生成完了まで届かない（固まったように見える）のを防ぎます。
